description: Test mode, standstill with traffic: an EU07 stands on track 2 of Stacja1 on td.scn while another EU07, AI traffic, leaves track 1 on the td/rozklad timetable at 10:35 and runs on. Only the train under test (test.vehicle, the case's vehicle) counts, so the test ends on test.standstill 100 although the traffic is moving; counting every vehicle, it would run into the 300 s test timeout.
